column1: # PARITY.tsv -- C-to-OM retirement ledger (REVIEW-LESSONS.md "C to OM migration"; checked by
# One `c` row per C file that a change deletes, or whose same-stem .om it adds or edits outside
# tests/. Columns (tab separated): kind, C path, ref (live = in the tree; else the commit that
# holds the deleted file), the make target holding the C-vs-OM differential (- when none),
# the functions it covers (every function the C file defines with external linkage that the
# differential reaches and compares; - when none), and every other such function as
# Covered means reached by the differential's corpus on the C reference and compared: measured
# with gcov on the C reference build (test-visor-effect-parity: 100% of visor_effect_request.c
# lines; visor_world.c: the unattached view only, the one view omega can show, pinned by
# file has no other external function (gen-protocol: main, byte-identical C and OM runs).
# A row with target - is a C file this change retired WITHOUT a differential in the tree; each
# reason says what checks the replacement instead. These rows are the open qualification debt.
# `check` rows (kind, file, deleted C stem, -, -, reason): an nm/objdump/grep line on retired C
# that is allowed without an OM scan.

pd0_null_world=differs by capacity: the OM ctrl_null_world stages at most 4 observed variables and 255 steps per episode (it traps above), the C 8 and any, worlds within that are byte-identical in test-pd0-verify-parity (an OM zero-step episode bug it found is fixed);pd0_mut_pad=differs by capacity: the OM ctrl_mut_pad stops at 32 terms per equation (V_MAX_TERMS), the C pads to 64 (parity_divergences.txt hand line 630), padding that stays within 32 terms is byte-identical in test-pd0-verify-parity

pd0_rec_write=differs by capacity: the OM vr_rec_parse and pd0_rec_encode (Pd0Rec) hold at most 4 observed variables, the C 8, so a record with 5..8 is refused by the OM (tests/physics0/verify/parity_divergences.txt hand lines 50 and 629, checked by test-pd0-verify-parity), every record with 1..4 is byte-identical there;pd0_rec_parse=differs by capacity: the OM vr_rec_parse and pd0_rec_encode (Pd0Rec) hold at most 4 observed variables, the C 8, so a record with 5..8 is refused by the OM (tests/physics0/verify/parity_divergences.txt hand lines 50 and 629, checked by test-pd0-verify-parity), every record with 1..4 is byte-identical there;pd0_rel_parse=differs by capacity: the OM vr_ slots hold at most 32 terms per equation (V_MAX_TERMS), the C 64, so an equation with 33..64 terms is PD0V_TOO_LARGE in the OM (parity_divergences.txt hand line 93), every other input is byte-identical in test-pd0-verify-parity;pd0_law_parse=differs by capacity: its relation block is read by the OM vr_rel_parse, which refuses equations of 33..64 terms (parity_divergences.txt hand line 93), every other law is byte-identical in test-pd0-verify-parity;pd0_ledg_append=differs by capacity: the OM vr_ledg_append copies the payload in a loop bounded at 8192 bytes (it traps above), the C has no cap, payloads up to 8192 bytes are byte-identical in test-pd0-verify-parity (its dumper buffer is 8192 bytes, so the larger case is not exercised)
